recentItems.title: Timeline: The downfall of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
recentItems.description:
Huang, who stepped down Thursday following reports of extramarital affairs, including with a suspected Chinese spy, was the very public face of a company that dominates the market for computer chips used to train and run AI models. His resignation has sent ripples through the global technology industry.

(Produced by Luke Garratt)

recentItems.title: Pope Leo XIV urges young Peruvians to find hope and purpose during Lima youth vigil
recentItems.description:
Pope Leo XIV drew tens of thousands of young people to Lima’s National Stadium on Thursday for a prayer vigil. Around 60,000 young people gathered inside the stadium, while authorities estimated another 300,000 people had congregated in the surrounding areas.

recentItems.title: Talarico says Trump can achieve historic accomplishments if he works with Democrats
recentItems.description:
James Talarico, the Democrat who won the Texas Senate race last week, said Trump can achieve glory on a par with Lyndon B. Johnson, and Democrats should work with him to do it. Talarico spoke Thursday at the What’s Next conference in Denver, where Democrats are discussing what to do with their new congressional majorities. (AP video shot by: Thomas Peipert)
